basic_info.description: Welcome to 107 Knockash Hill, tucked inside a gated enclave of thirteen homes, and just moments from West Portals vibrant shops, restaurants, and easy Muni access. This home delivers generous living space, refined finishes, and an inviting atmosphere from the moment you arrive.Step through a gracious entry into soaring ceilings, hardwood floors, and light-filled living spaces. The formal living room features a beautiful fireplace, while the adjoining dining room offers an elegant setting for gatherings. A bright, updated chefs kitchen boasts stainless-steel appliances, ample storage, space for entertaining, and a large island with bar-seating, perfect for everyday living. The spacious family roomcomplete with a second fireplaceopens to a private patio, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite impresses with vaulted ceilings, its own fireplace, and a spa-like bathroom. Additional bedrooms provide flexibility for guests or a home office. With five bedrooms, four and a half baths, and a smart multi-level layout, this home accommodates both entertaining and quiet retreat. An attached two-car garage adds convenience, while the location offers the best of both worlds: quiet gated community and quick access to the heart of the city.
